introHtml: Folding personal care items combine everyday essentials with space-saving portability, making them ideal for travel kits, gym giveaways, or corporate swag bags. Unlike standard toiletries that take up too much room, these compact designs — like folding combs or travel brushes — fit neatly in a pocket or purse. Perfect for imprinting your logo on a functional item that recipients will actually use on the go.
